name: claude-cost-framework
description: A model delegation ladder for Claude Code, plus an optional context-hygiene watcher.

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: Delegation ladder: six subagents (scout, researcher, worker, builder, judge, decider), the escalation and evidence rules read in at session start, a /handoff skill, and a local ledger of subagent runs.

plugins.name: context-hygiene
plugins.description: Watches how full a session's context is: a meter, a guard that blocks edits until a handoff is written, a large-read warning, and a handoff loader at session start.
